about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/machinegraph: edits of the machine graph reader that a test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/machinegraph (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded in wf10 binsize BS7b.

mutants.name: bs7b-generic-name
mutants.rule: binsize BS7b: two instances of one generic record in one union have variant names apart (their type arguments).

mutants.name: bs7b-alts-dropped
mutants.rule: binsize BS7b: a case of several tuple patterns takes the pairs each pattern takes, not the product of their variants.
